originality.rationale: The exact four-state directed-ring two-color classification, explicit neighboring-run Palm asymmetry, and leading cubic finite-lag word witness are not implied by the inspected published singleton-coarse-graining no-go, the three-symbol word no-go, or the generic coarse-grained irreversibility inference framework. Remaining publication-priority risk from broader hidden-state reversibility theory is genuine.

value.rationale: The smallest hidden architecture for a one-bit arrow of time, its complete rate boundary, and a measurable covariance plus four-snapshot witness address a natural detector-resolution limitation in nonequilibrium statistical mechanics. The result resolves a specific complete classification rather than a routine numerical special case. No claim about entropy-production magnitude or robust finite-sample sensitivity is needed for this structural value.
